a: A blended overnight oat pudding. Finely milled toasted oats, toasted hemp hearts, chia, protein and fiber hydrate overnight into something thick and creamy - closer to pudding than oatmeal. Then you add a flavor swirl and a crunch mix-in right before you eat it.

Pour the Sweet Cream Base into a jar or bowl, add about 2/3 cup (140-180 mL) of any milk, stir or shake, and refrigerate overnight. In the morning, squeeze in the swirl, tear open the crunch, eat. Make it. Swirl it. Crunch it.
